portable_air_pump.notes: siphon_0/off and siphon_1/on panels. Inserted_Tank and connector sockets; attached tank is separate. Pump-in/out uses same source appearance. No underfloor connection mesh.

space_heater.notes: Five radiator fins, heat/cool/standby/off source-state core panels; maintenance hinge. Improvised variant retains beaker socket and wiring. Geometry fits one 2m tile.

improvised_chemical_heater.notes: Five radiator fins, heat/cool/standby/off source-state core panels; maintenance hinge. Improvised variant retains beaker socket and wiring. Geometry fits one 2m tile.

electrolyzer.notes: Separate side electrodes, maintenance panel and source off/standby/working states. Working effect uses original sprite frames/timing, not a repainted texture; gameplay controls power and processing.

gas_crystallizer.notes: Tall transparent reaction chamber, product socket, maintenance panel and on/off source control. Gas connections are anchors only; pipe network excluded.

tank_compressor.notes: Hollow tank chamber, separate compression door and maintenance hatch. Source closes chamber when tank inserted; no tank is baked into mesh. Input/output ports remain sockets only.

breach_shield_generator.notes: Portable breach shield column. Original off/on/broken states on energy bands. Generated shields are separate gameplay objects, not baked geometry.

atmospheric_shield_generator.notes: Source is a thin non-solid rail, not a bulky tower. Place/rotate on the 2m grid; opposing generators create the field at runtime. Active/waiting/inactive lamp clips.
